_comment: Canonical sample of what the newsroom LLM produces per newspaper. Both sides of the pipeline test against this file — newsroom-director validates its output_schemas match this shape, gazette validates its Zod schemas accept it. Fields added AFTER the LLM call (newspaper_id, heroImageUrl, image_url, word_count) are intentionally absent here.

articles.headline: Markets Brace for Tariff Fallout
articles.body: Global markets opened sharply lower on Monday as investors weighed the long-term implications of the newly announced trade tariffs. Analysts warn the 10% baseline could ripple through supply chains for months.
articles.imagePrompt: A trader staring at falling stock charts on multiple screens, hands on head.

articles.headline: WHO Funding Crisis Escalates
articles.body: The World Health Organisation faces a structural funding shortfall following the withdrawal of its largest contributor. Emergency talks in Geneva failed to produce a replacement mechanism.

in_brief.headline: Bulgaria Joins Eurozone
in_brief.summary: Bulgaria formally adopted the euro on 1 January, becoming the 21st member of the single currency area after years of economic convergence criteria.

in_brief.headline: F1 Season Opener Safety Concerns
in_brief.summary: Aston Martin drivers flagged potential nerve damage from chassis vibration ahead of the Australian Grand Prix, prompting an emergency technical review.

editors_note: Today's edition reflects a world grappling with the economics of conflict and the slow erosion of multilateral institutions.
